Details 
$resp = Invoke-Sparql @'
SELECT distinct ?q ?label ?birthdate ?deathdate ?links ?descBylabel
 ?dict ?wp ?bigEnc ?bigEncOld ?orthEnc ?wikisource ?rusBioDict ?azlibru ?proDetLit
WHERE {
  VALUES ?descBy {
     wd:Q109277660 #XVIII 
   # wd:Q109277663 #XVIII vol1
   # wd:Q110027664 #XVIII vol2
   # wd:Q110027715 #XVIII vol3
     wd:Q125555152 #XIX
    #wd:Q125555255 #XIX vol1
    #wd:Q125555366 #XIX vol2
     wd:Q124467367 #XX
    #wd:Q124510026 #XX vol1
    #wd:Q124518167 #XX vol2
    #wd:Q124518168 #XX vol3
     wd:Q108611244 #spbXX
    }
  #{?q wdt:P1343 ?descBy. } UNION {?q wdt:P1343/wdt:P361 ?descBy.} # works, fast no dups
  {
    ?q p:P1343 ?stmt.
    ?stmt ps:P1343 ?descBy.
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?q p:P1343 ?stmt.
    ?stmt ps:P1343 ?intermediate.
    ?intermediate wdt:P361 ?descBy.
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?descBy rdfs:label ?descBylabel. FILTER ( lang(?descBylabel) = 'ru' ) }
  
  
  OPTIONAL {
  ?wp schema:about ?q . 
  ?wp schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikipedia.org/>.
  ?wp schema:name ?title .
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?stmt pq:P1810 ?namedAs. }
  OPTIONAL { ?q rdfs:label ?labelRu. FILTER ( lang(?labelRu) = 'ru' ) }
  BIND(COALESCE(?title,?namedAs, ?labelRu) AS ?label).
  
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P569 ?birthdate. }
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P570 ?deathdate. }
  
  OPTIONAL {?stmt pq:P2699 ?dict. }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?q wdt:P2924 ?bigEncOldId.
    wd:P2924 wdt:P1630 ?fmt.
    BIND(IRI(REPLACE(?bigEncOldId, "(^.*)", ?fmt)) AS ?bigEncOld)
  }
  OPTIONAL
  {
    ?q wdt:P11514 ?bigEncId.
    wd:P11514 wdt:P1630 ?fmt2.
    BIND(IRI(REPLACE(?bigEncId, "(^.*)", ?fmt2)) AS ?bigEnc)
  }
  OPTIONAL
  {
    ?q wdt:P5002 ?orthEncId.
    wd:P5002 wdt:P1630 ?fmt3.
    BIND(IRI(REPLACE(?orthEncId, "(^.*)", ?fmt3)) AS ?orthEnc)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?q p:P1343 ?stmt2.
    ?stmt2 pq:P805 ?article.
    ?article wdt:P1433/wdt:P361 wd:Q1960551 .
    ?rusBioDict schema:about ?article .
      ?rusBioDict schema:inLanguage "ru" .
      ?rusBioDict schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikisource.org/> .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?q wdt:P12614 ?id .
  wd:P12614 wdt:P1630 ?fmt4.
    BIND(IRI(REPLACE(?id, "(^.*)", ?fmt4)) AS ?azlibru)
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?articleWs schema:about ?q .
    ?articleWs schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikisource.org/>.
    BIND(IRI($articleWs) AS ?wikisource).
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?q p:P1343 ?stmtPdl .
    ?stmtPdl  ps:P1343  wd:Q124821483 .
    ?stmtPdl pq:P2699 ?proDetLit .
    
  }
 
  
  OPTIONAL { ?q wikibase:sitelinks ?links. }
  }
'@

# group by q
$ppl = Merge-ObjectArrays $resp q

$ppl | % {
  if ($_.birthdate -and $_.birthdate -NotMatch '^\d') {
   $_.birthdate = $_.birthdate | ? {$_ -match '^\d'}
  }
  if ($_.deathdate -and $_.deathdate -NotMatch '^\d') {
   $_.deathdate = $_.deathdate | ? {$_ -match '^\d'}
  }
  
  if ($_.birthdate.count -gt 1) {
   $_.birthdate = $_.birthdate | select -f 1
  }
  if ($_.deathdate.count -gt 1) {
   $_.deathdate = $_.deathdate | select -f 1
  }
  
  if ($_.birthdate) {
   $_.birthdate = $_.birthdate.Substring(0,10)
   Add-Member -inp $_ -NotePropertyName birthDecade -NotePropertyValue ($_.birthdate.Substring(0,3)/1*10) -Force
  }
  if ($_.deathdate) {$_.deathdate = $_.deathdate.Substring(0,10)}
  
  $p = $_
  $_.psobject.properties | ? {!$_.value} | % {$p.psobject.properties.remove($_.name)}
}

$ppl | % {
if ($_.label.count -gt 1) {
 $_.label = $_.label | select -f 1
}
}

$urlNames = '?proDetLit ?dict ?wp ?bigEnc ?bigEncOld ?orthEnc ?wikisource ?rusBioDict ?azlibru' -replace '\?' -split ' '
$ppl | % {
  $p = $_
  $urls = $urlNames | ? {$p.$_} | % {
   $n = $_
   $p.$n | % { "<a href=$_>$n</a>"}
  } | Join-String -sep ' '
  if ($urls) {
   Add-Member -inp $_ -NotePropertyName urls -NotePropertyValue $urls -Force
  }
  $urlNames | ? {$p.$_} | % {$p.psobject.properties.remove($_)}
}

$ppl | sort {[int]$_.links} -Descending | Format-HtmlTable -Description (gcb -raw) -GroupBy descBylabel,birthDecade -OutVariable html | Invoke-Item
0 rows
